feeds.title: Emily Bites
feeds.description: Welcome to Emily Bites, a cooking blog proving that healthy can be delicious by offering lightened up recipes that never compromise on flavor. All recipes include Weight Watchers Points values!

feeds.title: Simple Nourished Living Blog
feeds.description: Learn to balance your love of food and life with healthy resources, success stories and recipes. Browse hundreds of weight watcher-friendly recipes for breakfast, lunch and dinner and learn how a slow cooker can be your best friend to keep the pounds off long-term!

feeds.title: The Skinny Kitchen
feeds.description: Quick and easy recipes with nutrition facts and calories. Weight Watchers friendly recipes with points.

feeds.title: Recipe Diaries
feeds.description: Hey, I'm Jenna a just a 35-year-old girl. I like to try different diets but mostly I lean towards Weight Watchers or Low Carb. My blog mostly consists of diet recipes from Weight Watchers or Low Carb.

feeds.title: Midlife Healthy Living Blog
feeds.description: Empty nest, Weight Watchers mom, enjoying a healthy lifestyle, spending time with her husband, thrift shopping & discovering new travel destinations.

feeds.title: Meal Planning Mommies
feeds.description: Hello! My name is Alisha. I am the voice, chef, and mom behind MPM. Meal Planning Mommies is a resource that dishes up Weight Watchers friendly meal plans, recipes, resources, and fun to your family table while encouraging moms to find satisfaction, enjoyment and peace of mind in the kitchen!

feeds.title: Smiley's Points
feeds.description: Weight Watchers Recipes and Support.

feeds.title: Keeping On Point
feeds.description: Keeping On Point offers delicious recipes and making them healthier.

feeds.title: Weight Off My Shoulders
feeds.description: My name is Dani. I grew up HATING running. I gave it a shot in 2005-2006 before suffering an injury that took me out of the running game until basically June 2011. Since being cleared to be active after surgery, I've been a running junkee.. and loving it. Thiis is mainly a blog about my journey with all things weight (80+ lbs shed) and health, I might as well give a little background on that.

feeds.title: Lindsay is a Lifetime Member
feeds.description: I am a Lifetime Member of Weight Watchers after having lost 130 pounds. I have kept most of my weight off by attending my meetings each week, tracking my food, and getting in some activity. Join me as I blog about my maintenance journey and about life in general.

feeds.title: Slimming Kitchen Secrets
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Laura, Weight Watchers Gold Member, northern lass and healthy cooking enthusiast bringing you delicious Smart Pointed recipes from my kitchen to yours.

feeds.title: The WW Foodie Blog
feeds.description: The Weight Watching foodie: Essex born, Yorkshire based, torn between the love of food and a desire to rediscover a size 10 waistline.

feeds.title: Pinch Of Nom Blog
feeds.description: Selection of the best slimming world recipes online, breakfast, lunch, dinner, fakeaways, desserts, and many more as well as cooking hints, tips, and advice. Pinch of Nom originally started as a simple idea in 2015 between partners Kay & Kate to share their recipes with friends and family, they created this as a tool for posting recipes and helpful information.

feeds.title: Jenn Cooks » Weight Watchers
feeds.description: Sharing my favorite healthy recipes!

feeds.title: Danica's Daily
feeds.description: Danica has a passion for all things food. She believes in and follows the Weight Watchers principle of all things in moderation and chronicles her culinary adventures here. Besides sharing her daily eats and tasty, nutritious recipes, Danica connects others seeking a healthier lifestyle on her other site Friends For Weight Loss.

feeds.title: LaaLoosh
feeds.description: Delicious Weight Watchers recipes online at LaaLoosh with weight watchers points plus. Get healthy and easy to make low-calorie recipes, free diet and cooking tools, product reviews, and more.

feeds.title: Nourish & Lift!
feeds.description: Here in Nourish & Lift, we help regular people like you and me with healthy eating, stay fit and live better. Featuring anything from product reviews, health articles, tips and more.

feeds.title: Weight Watchers Recipes with SmartPoints
feeds.description: Easy Weight Watchers recipes with points & old point values, nutritional information, and mouth-watering photos.

feeds.title: Dash of Herbs Blog
feeds.description: A food blog dedicated to easy, healthy recipes from scratch in about 30 minutes. All recipes include Weight Watchers Points.

feeds.title: The Weight of My Weight
feeds.description: My Blog is my personal weight loss journey. At times, this journey weighs heavy on my mind, other times, I find the humor in it and life in general. My ultimate goal is to be healthy, maintain my weight and hopefully inspire others to do the same authored by Weight Watcher Leader.

feeds.title: If You Have An Egg
feeds.description: The story behind the egg This group and my blog are dedicated to my fearless Weight Watchers leader Gwen. She is the bravest and most transparent weight loss partner I have. After five or six half-hearted but well-meaning attempts with WW before, my dear friend Karen and I decided to give Gwen's group another go.

feeds.title: The Daily Diary of a Winning Loser
feeds.description: Sean Anderson author of the blog shares his weight loss journey, on how he lost weight from 505 pounds to 230 pounds.

feeds.title: The Skinny Doll - This girl is losing it!
feeds.description: Just a girl on a journey to make her life healthier, brighter & more beautiful. Losing it one pound at a time. The blog is written by me and me alone. I do not represent Weight Watchers or any other weight loss or beauty brand. I'm following the Weight Watchers plan, Smart Pointing everything, eating less and moving more! Everything review is personally tried and tested by me!

feeds.title: Sparkly Runner
feeds.description: Welcome to my blog. I'm Sarah. Running has truly changed my life in the most astounding ways. This blog is my way of giving back to this incredible community. Here you'll find race recaps, training updates, product reviews, experience with weight loss and weight maintenance and other stories from the road- the good, the bad, and the ugly.

feeds.title: Keep It Up, David!
feeds.description: My name is David. I live in Los Angeles, and I'm 37 years old. In January 2010, I began eating better and exercising more, so I could lose weight. So far, so good - I've lost and kept off 160 pounds! But it's a tough road, and I need to keep finding new ways to keep motivated and on-track. I'll blog about my progress and share my struggles and successes. Join me on my journey!

feeds.title: Weight Watcher Girl
feeds.description: This page is about Losing Weight and Loving Yourself!! As you lose weight you still need to take care of yourself along the way! I share Low point delicious Recipes, Motivation, Weekly Grocery Finds, and my favorite makeup and tips! Join me and let's get the Weight off TOGETHER! YOU CAN DO IT!

feeds.title: Loving No Count
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Helen. I'm a Weight Watchers Gold Member. I've been following the Weight Watchers No Count plan since August 2016 and have been amazed by the weight loss results I have achieved. There's not a lot of information out there about No Count, so I decided to venture into the world of web design in order to help all you would-be No Counters. Over the past year, I've created and adapted recipes for No Count which I'd like to share with you on this website.

feeds.title: debby weighs in
feeds.description: I'm a 58-year-old retired NICU nurse currently working full time as a quilt artist. The year I turned 50 I started a weight loss journey that ended in 100 pounds lost. There've been lots of twists and turns in the road, but I am currently maintaining that loss. The journey's not over. Come along with me as I navigate the rocky road of maintenance.

feeds.title: Getting Fit Again in my 40s
feeds.description: I spent my 30s falling in love, getting married, having 2 kids, and gaining a lot of weight. I lost 35 lb in 2010, only to gain it all back and 20 more. So here I go again!

feeds.title: Maintaining Ain't Easy
feeds.description: Lost weight and keeping it off is hard. Self-honesty is my key.Weight Watcher goal and lifetime achieved and lost in 2018. Still a WWer and journaling my struggles and thoughts.

feeds.title: Diana's Journey
feeds.description: This blog is about me. It was orignally about my struggles with weight loss, but it has become much more. It's about my battle with cancer, the end of a 25-year marriage, a new love and yes, it's still about trying to lose weight and get healthy. It's really a journey of my life.

feeds.title: Suzanne's Kitchen
feeds.description: Following Weight Watchers and trying to be healthy.I'm currently following points plus but I also do simply filling

feeds.title: a dash of flavour
feeds.description: Many of the recipes lower in fat count etc as we are all on our own journey to be healthy at one time or another... for me it seems to be every Monday morning LOL!!!!

feeds.title: Pointed Kitchen
feeds.description: Whichever Weight Watchers plan you follow (Blue, Purple, Green or Freestyle) you'll find tasty recipes here. All pointed to make it easier to stay on track.

feeds.title: DwardCooks
feeds.description: Founded by a chef and food blogger, DwardCooks is a blog dedicated to sharing delicious and easy-to-make comfort food recipes. From classic mac and cheese to hearty stews and casseroles, you'll find everything you need to make the perfect comfort meal. Follow DwardCooks to find out more about the world of comforting cuisine.

feeds.title: Skinnytaste
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Gina Homolka, author, photographer and recipe developer of Skinnytaste.com which features delicious, healthy, family-friendly recipes made with real food. All my recipes here on Skinnytaste include nutritional info as well as Weight Watchers Points.

feeds.title: Slender Kitchen
feeds.description: Find the latest easy and healthy recipes that your whole family will love. Plus videos, healthy living advice, meal planning ideas, and more. Our goal is simple to provide you with delicious, healthy, wholesome recipes and meal plans that help you reach your health goals and enjoy mealtime again.

feeds.title: Drizzle Me Skinny Blog
feeds.description: My name is Kate and I have been a WW member since 1998 which is when I first earned my lifetime. I struggled with weight for 11 years! Until 2014 when I decided to get my life back. I started my journey January 2014 and in early November I once again earned my lifetime back, losing 45 pounds 🙂 I now blog all my recipes for everyone else to enjoy.

feeds.title: Runs for Cookies
feeds.description: In August 2009, I went on a mission to lose 100 pounds. I lost 125 pounds in 16 months, and now I'm doing my best to keep it off. Unwilling to give up my love affair with cookies, I became a runner along the way, hoping to achieve a nice balance.

feeds.title: Eat Crunchy
feeds.description: Three sisters losing weight on Weight Watchers.

feeds.title: robynnedevine
feeds.description: I have battled my weight since I was in my early twenties. I have spent the last several years getting bigger and bigger. I contemplated trying to lose weight but was so afraid to fail again. This time, my journey started with a new outlook.
